sentences.text:
Applicant :- Priti Gupta
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Shishir Kumar Tiwari

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for applicant, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and perused the record.
2.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the impugned summoning order dated 02.1.2024, arising out of Complaint Case No. 10229 of 2023, under Sections 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. P.S. Kasia, District Kushinagar, pending before the Judicial Magistrate, Kasia, Kushinagar.
It is also prayed to stay the further proceeding of aforesaid case during pendency of the present application.
3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is sister-in-law (bhabhi) of opposite party No. 2.

A complaint was filed by opposite party No. 2 against her husband and his family member as Case Crime No. 2390 of 2021, under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506 & 406 I.P.C.
and 3/4 D.P. Act.

It is further submitted that no such incident took place as mentioned in the F.I.R.
It is submitted that there is no evidence of involvement of applicant in the crime.
No case under Sections 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. is made out against the applicant.

4. Per contra learned Additional Government Advocate opposed the contentions made by learned counsel for the applicants and submitted that complainant as well as witness of the present case have supported the version of complaint in the statement recorded under Sections 200 and 202 Cr.P.C.

The cognizance order has been passed after considering the evidence available on record,

the prayer for quashing of the entire proceedings of aforesaid case, is refused.
